FAQS.question: How do online admissions work at Learnist Academy?
FAQS.answer: Admissions are 100% digital and paperless. Select your target exam, choose your course or batch, and complete enrollment online. You get instant access to the digital student dashboard, live class schedule, and study library within 60 seconds.

FAQS.question: Can I book a free demo before enrolling?
FAQS.answer: Yes! You can book a complimentary live online demo class for any course. Click "Book Free Demo", pick your preferred date and time slot, and join the interactive live session from your laptop or phone.

FAQS.question: Can I switch my batch or target year after enrollment?
FAQS.answer: Yes, batch flexibility is built into our online model. You can request a batch transfer or target-year shift through your student portal or by raising a quick request with our academic counselors without any penalty.

FAQS.question: Are there EMI or installment options available for course fees?
FAQS.answer: Yes, we provide 0% interest monthly EMI options across major credit cards, debit cards, and trusted Indian education financing partners on all comprehensive programs.

FAQS.question: Are there any hidden costs for test series or study notes?
FAQS.answer: None whatsoever. The course fee is all-inclusive. It covers live classes, recorded lecture vaults, printable PDF notes, full online mock tests, and 24/7 doubt resolution for the entire validity period.

FAQS.question: What online payment methods do you accept?
FAQS.answer: We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking across all Indian banks, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, and digital wallets.

FAQS.question: What is your refund and cancellation policy?
FAQS.answer: We offer an unconditional 7-day money-back guarantee on all comprehensive full-course programs. If you feel the online teaching does not match your learning style within 7 days of course commencement, submit a 1-click refund request for a 100% refund.

FAQS.question: How long does a refund take to process?
FAQS.answer: Once approved, refunds are credited back to your original source of payment within 4 to 6 business days.

FAQS.question: How do live online classes work?
FAQS.answer: Live classes stream in HD with two-way audio interaction, live chat, real-time polling, and digital whiteboard annotations. You can ask questions in real time via voice or chat.

FAQS.question: What happens if I miss a live online class?
FAQS.answer: Every single live lecture is automatically recorded in HD and uploaded to your student portal within 2 hours. You can re-watch unlimited times with variable playback speeds (0.75x to 2x).

FAQS.question: Are batch schedules flexible for college students or working professionals?
FAQS.answer: Yes. Most categories have both early morning cohorts (7:00 AM – 9:00 AM) and late evening cohorts (6:30 PM – 9:30 PM), as well as dedicated weekend tracks.

FAQS.question: How are online mock tests conducted?
FAQS.answer: Tests simulate the exact CBT (Computer Based Test) environment of exams like JEE, SSC, or Banking, featuring sectional timers, negative marking, instant scorecards, and national percentile ranks.

FAQS.question: How does online doubt solving work?
FAQS.answer: You have 3 modes of doubt support: 1) Live in-class voice/chat Q&A with the master educator; 2) Post-class daily live doubt lounges; 3) 24/7 Photo Doubt Assistant on your portal where expert teaching assistants reply within 30 minutes.

FAQS.question: Can I request a 1-on-1 online academic mentorship session?
FAQS.answer: Yes! Enrolled students in comprehensive courses get bi-weekly 1-on-1 online video mentorship slots to review weak topics, strategy, and test performance analysis.

FAQS.question: Is doubt support available on weekends and holidays?
FAQS.answer: Yes, our online doubt desks operate 7 days a week from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM IST.

FAQS.question: What devices are supported for attending classes?
FAQS.answer: Learnist Academy runs seamlessly across any modern web browser on Laptops, Desktops (Windows/macOS/Linux), Android tablets/smartphones, iPads, and iPhones.

FAQS.question: What internet speed do I need for streaming live lectures?
FAQS.answer: Our adaptive video player adjusts dynamically. A stable connection of 2 Mbps is sufficient for smooth 720p streaming. For audio-only or mobile data, low-data modes are also supported.

FAQS.question: Can I download lecture notes and study material offline?
FAQS.answer: Yes. All topic notes, mind-maps, question sheets, and formula cheat-sheets are available as downloadable PDFs that you can save or print anytime.

FAQS.question: Can I log in from multiple devices?
FAQS.answer: You can log in from your laptop and mobile device. For security and anti-piracy, simultaneous live streaming on more than two devices at the exact same instant is restricted.

FAQS.question: Do you provide printed physical books to my home?
FAQS.answer: Learnist is 100% digital and eco-friendly. All materials are provided in high-resolution interactive digital formats and printable PDFs with embedded solution links.
